answer_4.quote: We randomly select 50 test instances and use the model trained on 500 instances to generate the labels and explanations. Then we ask humans to infer the classification labels based solely on the generated explanations. The consistency is measured by whether the human-inferred label equals the label predicted by the model.
answer_4.guideline: human annotators infer labels from generated explanations and consistency with model predictions is recorded
